description.narrative: The main aim is to address violence and crime with a specific target of at risk groups that use their sentence time as a learning opportunity in promoting robust changes among the prisons population, to enhance awareness and fight abuses, providing them with all instruments capable to create better people and different mind sets through education, professional skills, entrepreneurship, mental help, medical assistance and the introduction of human right
